name: Iconosquare
summary: Social analytics, reporting and competitor benchmarking, deepest on Instagram and the core networks. Tiers gate on seats and profiles, so agencies managing many brands climb faster than the entry price suggests.
best_for: agencies and brands that want deep social analytics, reporting and competitor benchmarking alongside scheduling, especially Instagram-first teams
skip_if: you need a heavy-duty publishing workhorse across many niche platforms, or a single free native analytics view already answers your questions
honest_knock: Its depth is strongest on Instagram and the core networks; if your priority platform sits outside its best-supported set, coverage thins. Analytics is where it shines: scheduling and community features exist but aren't always as deep as dedicated publishers. And the per-seat, per-profile tiering means agencies managing many brands climb toward the Custom plan quicker than the headline Starter price suggests: Starter and Launch carry one seat and five profiles at most, Scale three seats and up to 20 profiles at €219 billed yearly, and only Custom goes beyond that.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter (1 user, 3 profiles) · per month billed yearly (EUR 11 month to month) for 3 profiles, 1 user and 30 posts a month
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-10-03 and 2026-11-21) Read on iconosquare.com/pricing (now served at /plans-and-pricing) from a Netherlands connection, with both billing toggles. Free covers 2 social profiles, 1 user and 10 posts a month per profile, with one month of analytics history. Starter now carries a profile selector: €9 a month billed yearly (€11 month to month) for up to 3 profiles, or €15 (€18) for up to 5, with 1 user and 30 posts a month. Launch is €33 billed yearly (€39 monthly) for 5 profiles, 1 user and 100 posts. Scale, badged Most popular, is the first tier with 3 users, unlimited posts, one group and two years of history, and it is priced by profile count: €69 billed yearly (€83 monthly) for 5 profiles, €119 (€143) for 10, €169 (€203) for 15 and €219 (€263) for 20. Custom starts at €116 billed yearly or €139 month to month and covers 5 to unlimited profiles and 1 or unlimited users, with white-label reporting, API access and personalised onboarding. The page puts the yearly saving at €24 on 3-profile Starter (€36 on 5), €72 on Launch, €168 on 5-profile Scale and €276 on Custom. The ladder has been rebuilt twice since our 26 August reading over a US connection, which listed Launch $39, Scale $79 and an Excel tier at $139: by mid-September Excel had folded into Custom and Starter had appeared below Launch, and by 3 October Starter and Scale had each gained a profile selector, so Scale now reaches 20 profiles before Custom is needed. The profile count is the dial that moves the price, so a quote taken at five says little about what a team managing twenty will pay. Re-read on 21 November 2026 on iconosquare.com/plans-and-pricing: Starter from €9 (3 profiles) or €15 (5), Launch €33, Scale €69 to €219 for 5 to 20 profiles and Custom from €116, all billed yearly, with the same yearly savings (€36, €72, €168, €276), so the monthly rates behind them are unchanged. The FAQ now adds that extra profiles can be bought on Scale and Custom through sales, and that X (Twitter) is only available from Launch up. Re-read 24 November 2026: the same ladder (Starter €9 or €15, Launch €33, Scale €69 to €219, Custom from €116, all billed yearly) and the same yearly savings.
